title: Sandpiper's Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set directly along the Gulf in Seagrove Beach, this remarkable beachfront residence offers an exceptional blend of privacy, sophistication, and effortless coastal living. Private beach access leads from the pool deck straight to the sugar-white sand, creating a seamless connection between the home and the shoreline. Expansive terraces invite relaxed outdoor living, while a resort-style pool and spa provide a tranquil setting for sun-filled afternoons and evening gatherings. Seasonal beach setups further elevate the experience, allowing days on the water to unfold with ease and comfort.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
